articles.summary: Falcon’s Beyond highlights previously disclosed scope as lead creative designer for newly renamed Mattel City at VAI Resort Falcon’s Beyond Global, Inc. (Nasdaq: FBYD) (“Falcon’s Beyond,” “Falcon’s,” or the “Company”), a global leader in visionary experiences and technologies, today highlighted its role providing lead creative design and attraction development services for the newly renamed Mattel City at VAI Resort in Glendale, Arizona. Mattel City As previously disclosed, Falcon’s Beyond entered into agreements with VAI Resort in May and June 2026 to provide attraction systems and lead design consulting services for a theme park development in Arizona. In connection with VAI Resort’s unveiling of the newly renamed Mattel City, Falcon’s is highlighting its role as the lead creative designer for the park, which is being expanded to transform the destination into a multi-day entertainment experience.
